stem: Which statement from the article describes a positive result of Washington’s military strategy?

options.label: A
options.text: And in November 1780, based on information from Woodhull, Major Tallmadge led a successful raid on Fort St. George on Long Island.

options.label: B
options.text: He regularly used such tricks as secret agents, double agents, and codes.

options.label: C
options.text: The Culper Ring operated for six years in and around New York City.

options.label: D
options.text: Sometimes the spies wrote their secret messages between the lines of a letter to a friend or business partner.
